description: Caller requests a date that resolves to a clinic holiday via relative date expression.
turns: Dr. Rao se kal milna hai.

expected.notes: today=2026-10-01 (Thursday), kal=2026-10-02 (Friday) which is a clinic holiday. A naive agent either does not resolve relative dates against the provided today field, uses the system clock, or forgets to check the holidays list. search_slots must return empty with reason=clinic_closed. Since the caller never offers an alternative date, the conversation ends abandoned.
